items.briefing:
Microsoft has released its largest ever Patch Tuesday update, fixing nearly 1,000 security vulnerabilities — two of which are already being actively exploited by attackers. Australian organisations should prioritise applying these updates as soon as possible. Separately, a local report highlights that accidental AI data exposure is now the second most common AI-related security incident in Australia and New Zealand, meaning staff may be unknowingly sharing sensitive information with AI tools.

Google has also warned that cyber attackers are increasingly using AI "agents" — automated systems that can act independently — to carry out attacks faster and at greater scale.

**Tip:** Check with your IT team that Microsoft's September updates have been applied to your devices this week.
